text:
maria: quick heads up, user-reported weirdness: operator override to change routing policy for tenant showed split behavior across requests. some traffic honored 'cost' override, some still went to 'latency' pool.

devon: ugh. can you share how the override was applied and which runtime?

maria: console override payload: ```json
{
  "target": "tenant:A",
  "overrides": {"route_policy": "cost"},
  "ttl": 600
}
``` runtime `2025.11.3`. logs show staggered shard applies and a snapshot rehydrate overwrote one shard after the override.

lucas: sounds like a race between fanout and snapshot refresh. we should make apply idempotent and rev-gated.

aseem: agree. proposal: add a monotonic config_rev on overrides/snapshots and reject older revs during apply. also emit per-shard apply events so we can surface propagation status.

beth: UX: console should show a 'propagation' state with shard counts and a link to per-shard logs. add `/overrides/:id/status` API for polling.

devon: plan: router change to check rev and ignore older snapshots (lucas, 2d), console API + UI indicator (beth, 1d), runbook update and alerting (aseem/devon, 1d).

lucas: will add `config_rev` compare in router apply path and unit/integration tests that simulate mid-apply snapshot. will also emit `override.propagation.completed` event with tags (override_id, tenant, rev, success_count, total_shards, duration_ms).

beth: I'll add the status endpoint and wire a small amber state for partial propagation with tooltip explaining counts. also link events in UI for debugging.

maria: ops addition: auto-revert if >5% shards report apply error after T=30s and alert oncall. will add incident drill.

devon: deploy plan: push to staging, validate with simulated snapshot races, then canary 5% shards. monitor metrics `override.propagation.percent` and `override.apply.errors`. abort if errors >2%.

deploy-bot: router/patch-config-rev-check queued -> staging at 1765571800.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded at 1765571905.

devon: staging looks green. lucas, start canary?

lucas: initiating 5% shard canary.

maria: metrics show propagation -> 100% in ~8s during canary. UI shows propagated (100%).

beth: added status UI and a short note in the override flow about expected propagation time and rollback behavior.

maria: filed follow-up ticket https://redwood.local/ops/ISSUE-4821 for vector rev discussion and tenant-scoped revs.

aseem: note: consider per-scope revs (global/tenant/service) later to avoid cross-tenant churn. don't block initial rollout on that.

devon: agreed. next actions: lucas PR for router, beth API/UI, aseem + devon update runbook and alerts, maria run incident drill. ping when staging is green for prod canary. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all, closing thread. :party_parrot:
